title: TRINITY ESALC-I normal-mode GVPT2 and IR
summary: Acquire a Cartesian Hessian, certify frozen ESALC-I Wilson GF, displace its normal modes, acquire Cartesian Hessians, dipole derivatives and full rovibrational G matrices, transform complete finite-difference fields and solve curvilinear GVPT2 with polyad IR intensities.
gates: frozen ESALC-I chart and full vibrational rank
Wilson GF agreement with displacement-mode frequencies
complete symmetric F3/F4 and G'/G'' finite-difference stencils
complete first-to-third dipole derivatives from analytic Cartesian Jacobians or finite dipole-value differences in the same modes
GVPT2 resonance polyads and second-order IR transition moments
coordinate_policy: Use one frozen full-rank ESALC-I/SONIC chart and its body-fixed nonlinear realization. Obtain normal modes by Wilson GF from the reference Cartesian Hessian, then displace along those modes in ESALC-I coordinates. Transform Hessian, metric and dipole stencils in that unchanged basis.
backend_policy: KeyMaker authorizes Cartesian E/G/H and dipole-value or dipole-Jacobian providers at one electronic level; TRINITY owns finite differences, field transformation, GVPT2 and IR intensities.
